name: Fix admin action security issue
query: This plugin has an admin POST handler that verifies a nonce and dispatches a sanitized request task through a fixed callback map, but does not check the user's capability for the selected post. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wordpress-router to classify repo kind
Step 2: Run wp-project-triage to detect plugin structure
Step 4: Identify the POST handler code
Step 5: Verify nonce check exists with wp_verify_nonce() or check_admin_referer()
Step 6: Add a current_user_can('manage_options') check after nonce verification and before protected work
Step 7: Use appropriate capability (manage_options, edit_posts, custom cap)
Step 8: Sanitize/validate all input with sanitize_text_field(), absint(), etc.
Step 9: Use wp_unslash() before sanitization for $_POST data
Step 10: Reject request values not present in the hardcoded callback map
Step 11: Define the plugin-owned callbacks named by the map
Step 12: Check the appropriate object-level capability with current_user_can() before callback dispatch
Step 13: Stop without writing or invoking a callback when the nonce, allowlist, or capability check fails
Step 14: Escape all output with esc_html(), esc_attr(), etc.
success_criteria: Both nonce AND capability checks present and ordered before protected work
Appropriate capability used for the action
Only hardcoded plugin-owned callbacks can be selected
Invalid nonce, denied capability, and invalid callback do not write or invoke a callback
